text: No, the property has not lost tree cover since 2021. The latest observed loss event was in 2020, with 67.7 hectares of tree cover lost. Since then, only minor losses (0.4 hectares in 2021) occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, which are not counted as significant events. The JRC 2020 reference also confirms no forest cover remained by 2020, aligning with the Hansen data. No further losses meet the 0.5-hectare threshold after the baseline.
